description_zh: 发起智能语音机器人外呼任务
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi create-robot-task --task-name '任务测试' --dialog-id 10000230000 --corp-name '阿里巴巴通信技术（北京）有限公司' --caller 057100005678 --number-status-ident true --retry-type 1 --recall-state-codes 200010,200011 --recall-times 1 --recall-interval 5 --is-self-line false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRobotTask

parameters.help_en: The task name. The task name can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。支持中文和英文，不超过30个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the robot or communication script that is used to initiate the call.

You can log on to the [Voice Messaging Service console](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and choose **Intelligent Voice Robot** > **Communication Script Management** to view the communication script ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定机器人ID，即话术ID。表示选择哪个机器人话术发起呼叫。

您可以登录[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，选择**智能语音机器人**>**话术管理**查看话术ID
parameters.name: dialog_id

parameters.example: 阿里巴巴通信技术（北京）有限公司
parameters.help_en: The company name, which must be the same as the **enterprise name** on the qualification management page
parameters.help_zh: 公司名称。需和资质管理页面中的**企业名称**完全一致
parameters.name: corp_name

parameters.help_en:
The calling number.

You must use the phone numbers that you have purchased and separate multiple numbers with commas (,). You can log on to the [Voice Messaging Service console](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and choose **Real Number Service** > **Real Number Management** to view the numbers you purchased
parameters.help_zh:
外呼主叫号码。

必须是已购买的号码，多个号码使用半角逗号（,）隔开。您可以登录[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，在**语音号码**>**真实号管理**页面查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable number status identification. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

> If you set this parameter to **true**, the reason why a call is not answered is recorded
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用号码状态（早媒体）识别标识。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：不启用。
- **true**：启用。

> 设为**true**会记录通话未接听的原因
parameters.name: number_status_ident

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-redial. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables auto-redial.
*   **0**: disables auto-redial
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动重拨。取值：

- **1**：重拨。
- **0**：不重拨
parameters.name: retry_type

parameters.help_en:
The call state in which redial is required. Separate multiple call states with commas (,). Valid values:

*   **200010**: The phone of the called party is powered off.
*   **200011**: The number of the called party is out of service.
*   **200002**: The line is busy.
*   **200012**: The call is lost.
*   **200005**: The called party cannot be connected.
*   **200003**: The called party does not respond to the call
parameters.name: recall_state_codes

parameters.help_en:
The redial interval. Unit: minutes. The value must be greater than 1.

> The maximum redial interval is 30 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
重拨间隔。单位：分钟，必须大于1。

> 最大间隔为30分钟
parameters.name: recall_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to call the self-managed line. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

> If you set this parameter to **true**, calling numbers are not verified
parameters.help_zh:
是否调用自有线路。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：不调用。
- **true**：调用。

> 设为**true**不会对主叫号码做校验
parameters.name: is_self_line
